newsitem.title: USA: Ford recalls 138,000 cars for fan problems.
newsitem.headline: Ford recalls 138,000 cars for fan problems.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Tuesday it is recalling a total of 138,000 cars for cooling fan problems that can result in smoke or a fire.

Affected vehicles are 1992-1994 Ford Tempo and Mercury Topaz; 1992-1995 Ford Taurus and Mercury Sable; and 1992-1994 Lincoln Continental cars. The vehicles are in South Dakota, North Dakota, Nebraska, Minnesota, Iowa and Alaska.

Ford said the engine cooling fan may stall in blowing or heavy snow, high winds and low temperatures. If that happens and the defroster is turned or the fan motor is automatically activated, the cooling fan may overheat and cause wiring damage.

A Ford spokeswoman said there have been no injuries as a result of the problem. Owners can take their vehicles to dealers for modifications free of charge. The repairs will take about half a day, or could be longer depending on the dealer's schedule.
